```{=typst}
// ==============================================================================
// CONTINUOUS FIGURE / TABLE NUMBERING (APA 7)
// ==============================================================================
// For single-file books Quarto injects, after `hefa-style.typ`, a level-1
// heading rule that resets the figure, table and equation counters at every
// chapter. Without a chapter prefix that produces duplicates ("Irudia 1" in
// chapters 3 and 4). Typst applies the most recently defined show rule first,
// and `hefa-chapter-heading` does not pass the heading on, so re-applying it
// here keeps Quarto's reset from running. Must stay at the top of the body.
#show heading.where(level: 1): hefa-chapter-heading

// ==============================================================================
// COVER PAGE AND SHARED METADATA (PDF only)
// ==============================================================================
// The cover lives in its own Typst file (`templates/typst/hefa-cover.typ`).
#include "templates/typst/hefa-cover.typ"

// Load `metadata.tfg` again for the running headers. In the book PDF all files
// are joined into one Typst document, so these `#let` variables stay visible in
// later sections (`front-matter/aurkibidea.qmd` uses `lan-mota` and `egilea`).
#let config = yaml("_quarto.yml")
#let tfg = if "metadata" in config and "tfg" in config.metadata {
  config.metadata.tfg
} else if "tfg" in config {
  config.tfg
} else {
  (:)
}

#let egilea = tfg.at("egilea", default: "Ane Garcia Goikoetxea")
#let ikasturtea = tfg.at("ikasturtea", default: "2026/2027")
#let lan-mota = tfg.at("lan-mota", default: "Gradu Amaierako Lana (GRAL)")
#let zuzendaria = tfg.at("zuzendaria", default: "Daniel Losada Iglesias, dk.")

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// FRONT-MATTER HEADING HELPER
// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// `#prelim-heading("Title")` looks like a chapter heading but is plain text:
// unnumbered, not in the table of contents and not in the running headers.
// Used by `eskerrak.qmd` and `laburpenak.qmd`.
#let prelim-heading(title) = {
  v(1.2em)
  text(size: 16pt, weight: "bold", font: "EHUSans")[#title]
  v(0.25em)
  line(length: 3.5cm, stroke: 2pt + rgb("#5FD790"))
  v(0.6em)
}
```
